CheckTitle: PostgreSQL Flexible Server uses CMK encryption
Description: Verify that PostgreSQL Flexible Servers use CMK.
Risk: Default encryption is managed by Microsoft.

Code.Other: Data encryption with Customer-Managed Keys (CMK) must be enabled at server creation time. To enable CMK for an existing server, create a new PostgreSQL Flexible Server with CMK enabled and migrate the database using Point-in-Time Restore (PITR) or dump and restore.

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Postgresql Flexible Server Encrypted At Rest Using Cmk.
